title: EntitlementDecision
description: Authorization decision from Account Again. Answers: may this subject/service use this product/capability/provider? Authority: Account Again (not Local AI Control Center). Reconciled in E4.1 against Account Again's actual v1.0 runtime (account_again/services/entitlement_engine.py) — this is a pre-freeze v2.1.0 correction, not a v1 change (v1 remains untouched and frozen).

entitlementDecisionId.description: Unique, immutable identifier for this entitlement decision. Generated once per evaluation (ALLOW or DENY) and referenced by downstream evidence/audit records for traceability.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking to the business/AI-execution flow.

accountId.description: Account Again account identifier. Legitimately absent (null) for service-identity-only evaluations that have no human account in scope — e.g. a Specialist OS acting under a ServiceIdentity with no bound subject.

tenantId.description: Tenant/organization scope. Present whenever the decision resolves to a tenant; absent only for requests that supplied no tenant-resolvable identity at all.

decision.description: Authorization decision. CONDITIONAL is reserved for future use (e.g. step-up auth); the current engine only emits ALLOW/DENY.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason for the decision. This enum is generated to match account_again/services/entitlement_engine.py's REASON_CODES exactly (single source of truth is the Python runtime, not this schema — see scripts/export-reason-codes.py in ACCOUNT-AGAIN). A schema/runtime drift test in ACCOUNT-AGAIN (test_e4_1_reason_codes_canonical.py) fails the build if the engine ever emits a code outside this set.

capability.description: Requested AI capability (e.g., AI_CODE, AI_CHAT, AI_ARCHITECTURE, AI_QA, AI_INFRA_PLANNING, AI_RAG, AI_AGENT).

providerConstraints.description: Allowed providers for this capability, if constrained. Runtime shape: a single `allowed` array (not separate allowed/denied lists — the engine expresses constraint as an allowlist, absence of the key means unconstrained).

modelConstraints.description: Allowed models for this capability, if constrained. Same allowlist shape as providerConstraints.

localOnly.description: If true, only local (non-network-egress) providers are permitted for this capability. Top-level field in the runtime response (not nested under modelConstraints).

cloudAllowed.description: If false, no cloud provider may be selected for this capability regardless of provider/model allowlists. Enforced by the engine as of E4.1 — a cloud provider request when cloudAllowed=false or localOnly=true yields reasonCode=CLOUD_NOT_ALLOWED.

quotaRef.description: Reference to the quota/budget policy that was evaluated.

quotaRemaining.description: Remaining quota units after this decision (if applicable).

policyVersion.description: Version of the entitlement policy/engine that produced this decision.

evaluatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was evaluated.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the entitlement evaluation evidence, if a durable evidence record was produced beyond the audit log.
